item.title: Badar Khan Suri’s appeal hearing explained: Judges consider legality of redetention one year after initial arrest
item.description: Trump admin lawyers and Georgetown postdoctoral fellow Badar Khan Suri’s legal team sparred during oral arguments before the U.S. Court of Appeals.

item.title: Interim D.C. Metropolitan Police Chief says police don’t collaborate with ICE, but questions remain
item.description: The D.C. Council held a performance oversight hearing, addressing concerns surrounding MPD's level of involvement with federal authorities.

item.title: The entrance interview: the Wagner-Missaghi administration is putting in the work
item.description: With just over two months of the Wagner-Missaghi term down, the team sat down with the Voice to reflect on their accomplishments and goals.

item.title: The Pierce Reading Room’s new look brings mixed reactions from students
item.description: The Pierce Reading Room in Lauinger Library reopened to students after nearly a year of renovation on Jan. 12.

item.title: On Cloud 9, Megan Moroney sings an all-too-familiar tune
item.description: While her Moroney continues to please her fanbase, her failure to evolve artistically risks an ever-shortening fuse.

item.title: Georgetown women’s rowing opens its spring season
item.description: Georgetown women’s rowing opened its 2026 spring season on Sunday, March 22, competing in two separate events at the Occoquan Reservoir in Virginia.

item.title: Hoyas end difficult non-conference play with 12-18 loss at Syracuse
item.description: On Sunday, Mar. 22, Georgetown men’s lacrosse (3–4, 0–0 BIG EAST) fell 12-18 to No. 8 Syracuse University (8–2, 0–0 ACC). This game capped off a tough non-conference portion of the regular season

item.title: Author Eli Clare speaks on activism and community building amid targeting of minority communities
item.description: The Georgetown Disability Cultural Center and LGBTQ Resource Center hosted writer Eli Clare for a virtual discussion of his novel Unfurl.

item.title: Georgetown junior guard KJ Lewis to enter transfer portal
item.description: Hoya junior guard KJ Lewis is set to enter the transfer portal, he told On3, a college sports outlet, on Tuesday, March 24.
